title: Shopify Store Product, Pricing & Contact Intelligence Input

stores.title: Shopify Store Domains or URLs
stores.description: List of Shopify store domains or URLs to extract (e.g. ['allbirds.com', 'gymshark.com']).

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max Products Per Store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum number of products to extract per Shopify store (1 to 2500).

searchKeyword.title: Filter by Product Keyword (Optional)
searchKeyword.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter applied to product title, tags, or product type.

enrichStoreContacts.title: Extract Merchant Contact, Theme & Ad Pixel Stack
enrichStoreContacts.description: Also scan the store homepage for merchant contact emails, social media links, installed Shopify apps, ad pixels, and currency metadata.

concurrency.title: Max Concurrent Stores
concurrency.description: Number of Shopify stores processed in parallel.
